Harrys Hope is evidently on a good mark and feared for all her weak finishing tendencies remain a cause for concern. The consistent Ridin Solo can also feature on his first crack at 3m. races.display_title: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Having justified good support when successful on debut for Dan Skelton at Uttoxeter, ASHDOWN FOREST fared best of those held up in a messy race when third behind Ballynoe Boy at Market Rasen 3 weeks ago. He's well worth another chance to prove his revised mark a workable one and emerge victorious this time. La Lolita and Lucky in Taipan are others worth a second look. ASHDOWN FOREST (IRE) BALLYNOE BOY (IRE) LA LOLITA (FR)

races.verdict: HARD ENDEAVOUR is less exposed than most here and can progress again from his promising Sandown second to land this good prize. Course specialist Hickory is also shortlisted, with his win here in July looking strong form, whilst Ozat hasn't had the rub of the green on his most recent outings and likely remains on a competitive mark. races.display_title: WTW Willis Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: HOW'S ELLIE was still in front when crashing out at the final hurdle last time and can gain compensation here granted a better round of jumping. Ivatt showed fairly useful form on the Flat and should build on his third-placed hurdling debut at Tramore, while Astelia should be more competitive back in maiden company after disappointing at Galway. HOW'S ELLIE (IRE) IVATT ASTELIA (IRE)

races.verdict: ITSAWORKINMANIAM caught the eye when closing late on his Roscommon reappearance/handicap debut 31 days ago and, with the step up in trip expected to suit, looks worth chancing in an open-looking staying handicap. Mighty Berkshire arrives in good order and rates the main danger, while Sound Judgement remains unexposed as a stayer. ITSAWORKINMANIAM (IRE) MIGHTY BERKSHIRE (IRE) SOUND JUDGEMENT (IRE)

races.verdict: LOS BLANCO jumped soundly on chasing debut at Wexford and, with improvement anticipated from a yard second to none with chasers, he is selected to come out on top. Fou de Toi found chasing more to his liking than hurdling when second at Ballinrobe and looks the chief threat, while chase debutant Manoir de Mirande is bred to excel in this sphere if able to keep his quirks in check. LOS BLANCO (FR) FOU DE TOI (FR) MANOIR DE MIRANDE (FR)

races.verdict: PINOT GRIS posted a career best over hurdles at Galway last month and is expected to go close now returned to fences from a 6 lb lower mark. Hashtag Pretender showed a good attitude when opening his chase account at Roscommon last month despite several mistakes and is likely to prove the main danger if more assured in the jumping department and seeing out the trip. Charlie Luciano won at this course earlier in the summer and is also respected. PINOT GRIS (IRE) HASHTAG PRETENDER (FR) CHARLIE LUCIANO (IRE)

Preference goes to MY GREAT MATE , who shaped as if better for the run on return at the Galway Festival recently and Willie Mullins' 7-y-o should have no issues with this markedly longer trip. Affinity Rock is proving consistent since sent chasing, so looks an obvious threat, with Chanceawetmorning an interesting chasing debutant, as well. Elyatta failed to get competitive on nursery debut, but first-time blinkers may well eke out that bit extra, so he heads up the opposition, with Someday Somewhere and Romance taken to fight out third.
